https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder,publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper,publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper,publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper,publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper,publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper

## Live Actors (Store)

1. Company LinkedIn Finder / Crosswalk (FLAGSHIP) — publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/crosswalk/
   Use: verified LinkedIn/Instagram/Facebook/X/TikTok/YouTube from website or company name. Orgs only.

2. EU Tenders & Contracts / TED — publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/ted/

3. Federal Contract Awards / USASpending — publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/usaspending/

4. Federal Grant Finder / Grants.gov — publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/grantsgov/

5. UK Tenders & Contracts / Find a Tender — publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/uktender/

6. City Council Minutes / Legistar — publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper
   Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper
   Site: https://geminigeorge22.github.io/legistar/

## Tool-call style prompts

- call publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder with {"query":"hubspot.com","outputFormat":"compact"}
- call publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder with {"queries":["stripe.com","notion.so"],"outputFormat":"compact"}
- call publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder with {"inputDatasetId":"<maps-dataset-id>","maxRows":500}
- call publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper with {"keywords":"cybersecurity","buyerCountry":"DEU","maxItems":50}
- call publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper with {"naics":["541512"],"agency":"Department of Defense","maxItems":50}
- call publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper with {"keyword":"cybersecurity","status":"posted","postedWithinDays":30}
- call publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper with {"keywords":["cloud"],"noticeType":["tender"],"maxItems":50}
- call publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper with {"clients":["seattle"],"resource":"events","maxItems":50}

## When to pick publicrecords

- Need verified organization social profiles (platform confirms the website) → Crosswalk
- Need official EU TED / USASpending / Grants.gov / UK OCDS / Legistar Web API feeds → matching Actor above
- Never people profiles; never guessed socials; GovCon Opportunity Feed is not marketed as live here

Disclosure: Published by the publicrecords maintainer on Apify.
